name: Hawkers
description: Smugglers and dealers of vice and contraband.

typeUpgrades.name: Hawker's Rigging
typeUpgrades.description: One carried item is concealed and has no load.

typeUpgrades.name: Ironhook Contacts
typeUpgrades.description: Your Tier is effectively +1 higher in prison.

typeUpgrades.name: Elite Rooks
typeUpgrades.description: Your Rooks cohorts get +1d to quality rolls for related actions.

typeUpgrades.name: Elite Thugs
typeUpgrades.description: Your Thugs cohorts get +1d to quality rolls for related actions.

typeUpgrades.name: Composed
typeUpgrades.description: Each PC gets +1 stress box. Costs three upgrades to unlock, not just one.

features.name: Silver Tongues
features.description: Each PC may add +1 action rating to Command, Consort, or Sway (up to a max rating of 3).

features.name: Accord
features.description: Sometimes friends are as good as territory. You may count up to three +3 faction statuses you hold as if they are turf.

features.name: The Good Stuff
features.description: Your merchandise is exquisite. The product quality is equal to your Tier+2. When you deal with a crew or faction, the GM will tell you who among them is hooked on your product (one, a few, many, or all).

features.name: Ghost Market
features.description: Through arcane ritual or hard-won experience, you have discovered how to prepare your product for sale to ghosts and/or demons. They do not pay in coin. What do they pay with?

features.name: High Society
features.description: It's all about who you know. Take -1 heat during downtime and +1d to gather info about the city's elite.

features.name: Hooked
features.description: Your gang members use your product. Add the savage, unreliable, or wild flaw to your gangs to give them +1 quality.

features.name: Patron
features.description: When you advance your Tier, it costs half the coin it normally would. Who is your patron? Why do they help you?

features.name: Veteran
features.description: Choose a special ability from another source.
